heroCopy: WHITEROCK SURFACES VIETNAM operates a 20,000 m² specialized fabrication facility in Dong Nai, Vietnam. Engineered for North American hospitality, multi-family, and distributor programs with 0% US Section 301 tariff export compliance, high-capacity bridge sawing, quad-spindle CNC machining, pre-mounted undermount sinks, and export crate crating.

flowSteps.title: Material Batch Selection
flowSteps.copy: Direct inspection of jumbo engineered quartz slabs and imported Italian Carrara / Calacatta blocks with color lot coding.

flowSteps.title: Infrared Bridge Cutting & CNC
flowSteps.copy: Digital CAM nesting, automated cutting, sink basin routing, and standard 4"/8" faucet hole core drilling.

flowSteps.title: Edge Profiling & Sink Assembly
flowSteps.copy: Linear edge grinding, 85+ gloss diamond polishing, undermount sink mounting, and structural bracket bonding.

flowSteps.title: Full QC Dry-Lay & ISPM-15 Crating
flowSteps.copy: 100% surface and dimensional verification, unit labeling, protective foam corners, and heavy-duty fumigated wood crating.

inspectionPoints: Faucet hole spread & sink alignment check
qc.aql: Strict AQL 1.0 Major / AQL 2.5 Minor standard applied to all export shipments.
qc.tools: Digital Vernier calipers, surface gloss meters, straightness levels, dial gauges, and custom aluminum sink templates.
qc.thirdParty: Third-party quality inspection by SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek, or buyer-appointed QA representatives welcome prior to container seal.

capabilities: CAD/DXF architectural shop drawing creation and revision
Custom hospitality countertop mock-ups and sample kits
OEM/ODM private-label carton branding and barcode labeling
Custom drop-test carton packaging for e-commerce vanity dropship programs
rnd.sampleLeadTime: 3 to 5 business days for standard 4x4" chips; 7 to 10 days for full custom vanity mockups.

materials.copy: Engineered quartz slabs formulated with 93% pure natural quartz crystals and high-grade polyester resins. Natural marble and granite sourced directly from reputable European, Brazilian, and Indian quarries.
materials.traceability: Each export crate and vanity slab features permanent QR/barcode traceability linking to specific production shift, inspection logs, and raw material batch numbers.

packing.copy: Solid fumigated plywood crates with reinforced steel banding, inner EVA foam padding, heavy plastic moisture barrier, and edge corner protectors.
packing.loadability: Up to 240-350 pieces of prefab vanity tops per 40HQ container (approx. 26.5 tons max payload).
